body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Sony Korea presented its 30g entry-level mp3 player ‘NWD-B103F’ during KES 2007, which features 1GB capacity and built-in direct USB connectivity. Adopting voice recorder function, the NWD-B103F offers 12 hours of use with 2 hours of charging time. Suggested price is between 90,000(KRW) and 100,000(KRW).
